title: Quantum-sensor [R] claims and reference audit for OTA-TEC-0029 (optical lattice clocks, SQUIDs, atom interferometers)
question: Audit the exact OTA-TEC-0029 real-science layer: optical clocks, SQUIDs, atom interferometers, Dst and LOD/EOP claims, keeping uncertainty, stability, noise density, integration time, product definition and TRL separate.
why_now: OTA-TEC-0029 contains real sensor anchors but over-compresses heterogeneous metrics into institution-wide tables and includes a misdated Bothwell citation. Critical review is needed before reuse.
real_world_anchor: Real optical clocks, low-Tc SQUIDs, atom interferometers and IERS/Kyoto geophysical measurement products
novelty_reason: This companion document's own quantum-sensor, EOP and citation layer had not been critically reconciled.
